sn12.53:1.2: Saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati ||
sn12.53:1.7: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 3
sn12.53:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave telaṃ ca paṭicca vaṭṭim ca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya ||
sn12.53:2.2: tatra puriso kālena kalaṃ telam āsiñceyya vaṭṭim upasamhareyya ||
sn12.53:2.3: Evañhi so bhikkhave telappadīpo tadāhāro tad upādāno ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ jaleyya || 4
sn12.53:2.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave saññojaniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati ||
sn12.53:2.9: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 5
sn12.53:3.1: Saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.53:3.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 6
sn12.53:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave telaṃ ca paṭicca vaṭṭiṃ ca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya ||
sn12.53:4.2: tatra puriso na kālena kālaṃ telam āsiñceyya na vaṭṭiñca upasaṃhareyya ||
sn12.53:4.3: Evañhi so bhikkhave telappadīpo purimassa ca upādañassa pariyādānā aññassa ca anupāhārā anāhāro nibbāyeyya || || 7
sn12.53:4.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave saññojaniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati ||
sn12.53:4.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || ||
